mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% in a 3-month window signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0% (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand weakness, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing supply shock regime (INDPRO growth < 0.5% annually) reduces industrial output and corporate production capacity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: manufacturing supply shock regime (INDPRO growth < 0.5% annually)
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth < 0.5% annually (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth above 2.0% (GDPC1) indicates strong economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 2.0% (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals potential monetary tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Housing market downturn regime (HOUST < 450,000 units) reduces residential construction activity, lowering consumer confidence and aggregate demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 450,000 units (p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).
